summary: Advocacy groups including the ACLU are raising concerns about National Guard deployment in the District, while statehood supporters including Senator Slotkin have pledged to prioritize the issue. DC Vote marked the anniversary of a federal takeover, characterizing it as evidence for why statehood remains urgent. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
